Liquid

Start the server in Termux, then open the full page. Everything else is inside it.

1. First time onlyRun once in Termux. It installs everything and starts the server.
$ python ~/storage/downloads/liquid_all.py --setup
2. Every timeStarts the server and opens Chrome.
$ liquid
3. Already running?Open the full page (all commands, tools, reports).
localhost:8080
Profile picturePick any picture (or tap the logo at the top). It changes the logo, the background (sharp, not blurred) and the page icon here. When the Termux server is running it also becomes the app icon, the notification picture and the report picture.
